<summary>
Rounds 1-8 of 10 released; round 8 is being read now (board, changes.md, logs). Notes: /task/workspace/notes.md.

Log format: "2026-09-14T08:03:34Z WARN  checkout-api ...".

Threads:
- A: CERT_EXPIRED, ledger-svc and inventory-svc. Resolved (round-07/board.md:3). Mitigation record: CHG-136 (round-04/changes.md:4).
- B: checkout-api. Board says UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT, ongoing (round-04/board.md:4). Logs show only heap warnings, so the likely cause is MEMORY_LEAK. Refs: round-06/logs/checkout-api.log:17,24,35,42; round-07/logs/checkout-api.log:6,7,17,19,22.
- C: search-api, ongoing (round-07/board.md:4). Cause is BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT: http.max_inflight=-1 in build 4.16.4. Refs: round-07/logs/search-api.log:17,20,23,28,30; change record CHG-113 (round-01/changes.md:4).
- D: closed as a false alarm, not an incident (round-07/board.md:5).

Follow-ups:
- Open: POSTMORTEM_DRAFT, CAPACITY_REVIEW, DATA_BACKFILL, VENDOR_TICKET (round-07/board.md:6).
- Closed: CUSTOMER_COMMS (round-06/board.md:3).

Next: analyse round 8, advance and analyse rounds 9-10, then give the final answer.
</summary>
